text:
sarah_sales: Quick readout from Acme POC load run — posting results and asks. TL;DR: 200 qps mixed workload, observed p95=240ms, p99=1.6s, some outliers to ~3.5s. Need pricing delta for reserved burst and the security questionnaire filled. Details below.

devon_se: thanks — can you paste the workload profile and the exact load command? was KV cache enabled for chat?

sarah_sales: Workload breakdown: 60% short chat gen (prompt ~30 tokens -> ~200 token response), 30% embeddings (512 dim), 10% long text-gen (prompt ~1k tokens). KV cache: enabled for chat. Run command we used (run via loadbot):

```
loadbot run --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  --concurrency 200 --duration 300s \
  --mix "chat:60,embed:30,longgen:10" \
  --model redwood/gptx-7b:v2-int8 \
  --region us-west-2
```

loadbot: Load run complete — summary: qps=200, avg=120ms, p95=240ms, p99=1600ms, max=3520ms, errors=0.8% (mostly timeouts on long-gen requests).

mike_infra: looks like the tail spikes line up with long-gen requests. model variant is quantized-int8, right? region?

sarah_sales: right — redwood/gptx-7b:v2-int8 in us-west-2. Dedicated burst pool was configured but autoscale did not kick because the test window was short.

devon_se: quick mitigation notes: 1) increase burst window to 180s so autoscale can allocate GPUs, 2) enable adaptive batching for embeddings, 3) raise per-request timeout to 10s for long-gen, 4) consider reserving a small Dedicated pool for predictable long-gen throughput. For pricing: sales should include reserved delta + per-token env.

ellen_prod: FYI customer also requested completed security questionnaire and KMS flow diagram. They want CMK with HSM-backed keys if possible.

sarah_sales: confirmed — they asked for customer-managed keys and a brief SSO/SAML note. Action items: 
  1) devon_se -> short runbook for burst window + batching tweaks, include config snippet.
  2) mike_infra -> check autoscale logs for the run and confirm why it didn't scale.
  3) sales -> draft pricing delta (hosted per-token vs monthly reserved for this 200qps mixed).
  4) ellen_prod -> send security questionnaire answers + KMS flow doc.

devon_se: I'll PR the runbook. snippet for batching config: 

```json
{
  "adaptive_batching": true,
  "max_batch_size": 128,
  "embedding_batch_size": 256,
  "burst_window_secs": 180,
  "request_timeout_secs": 10
}
```

sarah_sales: Perfect — please drop the PR link here when ready. sales team, will follow up for pricing; aim to get a draft by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

loadbot: marker: run_id=acme-2026-03-21-17 summary_uploaded

sarah_sales: thanks all — will update the customer after dev/infra confirms autoscale logs and we have the pricing delta and security docs.
